name: room_materials
character: octave absorption coefficients for six surface families, the library a space preset's geometry names
note: Absorption coefficient alpha per octave band, 0 = a perfect mirror, 1 = all absorbed. Source: the classic Sabine tables (Everest, Master Handbook of Acoustics, table of absorption coefficients) rounded to two decimals; the room engine applies sqrt(1-alpha) per bounce in amplitude.
sources: Everest & Pohlmann, Master Handbook of Acoustics, absorption-coefficient tables
cross-checked against a second published absorption table
